title.en: AN ACT SEPARATING THE SITIO OF PANGAYLAN-IP FROM BARANGAY POBLACION I IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF SANTIAGO, PROVINCE OF AGUSAN DEL NORTE, AND CONSTITUTING IT INTO A DISTINCT AND INDEPENDENT BARANGAY TO BE KNOWN AS BARANGAY PANGAYLAN-IP

text.en:
Creation of Barangay Pangaylan-IP. - The
sitio of Pangaylan-IP is hereby separated from Barangay
Poblacion I in the Municipality of Santiago, Province of
Agusan del Norte and constituted as a distinct and independent
barangay to be known as Barangay Pangaylan-IP.

2

Territorial Boundaries. - The territorial
boundaries of Barangay Pangaylan-IP are hereby described
"Bounded on the North by Barangay Poblacion II;
On the East by Provincial Boundary of Agusan del Norte
and Surigao del Sur;
On the West by Barangay Poblacion I and Barangay
Poblacion II; and
On the South by Barangay Poblacion I."

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. - The
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission
on Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Provincial Ordinance
No. 266-2010 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the Province
of Agusan del Norte, which ratified the creation of Barangay
Pangaylan-IP as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers
on March 5, 2011 shall serve as substantial compliance with the
plebiscite requirement under Section 10 of the Local Government
Code of 1991, as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
elected barangay officials of Barangay Pangaylan-IP shall
continue to hold office until such time that their successors
have been duly elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities.
public infrastructure and facilities existing therein at the time
of the approval of this Act are hereby transferred without
cost or compensation to and shall be administered by the new
Barangay Pangaylan-IP.

Internal Revenue Allotment Shares. - Barangay
Pangaylan-IP shall be entitled to internal revenue allotment (IRA)
shares pursuant to Section 285 of the Local Government Code
of 1991, as amended.

3

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15)
days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a
newspaper of general circulation.
